title: Draftpack Envelope
description: The `draftpack.json` member of a .draftpack: one accepted Baseline's signed manifest. Versioned by format_revision rather than schema_version, because the format is owned by draft-draftpack-contract and is Core-free — a recipient verifies a pack without running Draft.

signer.description: Who signed, and with which key. Level 2 of three: it says the bytes are unchanged and that whoever held the key produced them, never that the key is trusted in the importing project.

baseline.description: The exact accepted Baseline this pack carries. History, not authority: it says what the exporting project accepted, and nothing about what the importing project accepts.

entries.description: Every member with its exact digest, canonically ordered by path. Per-entry rather than one archive digest, so a mismatch says which member is wrong and a silently added or removed member is a manifest mismatch rather than an unnoticed difference.

receipts.description: Receipts travelling with the pack, embedded so a recipient can check the attestations without contacting the exporter. Evidence of what was attested; never a grant of local trust.
